bagPolicy.summary: Acrisure Stadium enforces a clear bag policy to enhance security, allowing clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small non-clear bags up to 4.5" x 6.5". Each fan can carry one approved clear bag and a clutch purse.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12"
Small non-clear bags not exceeding 4.5" x 6.5"
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items and diaper bags are permitted after inspection.

parking.note: Acrisure Stadium offers various parking options including the new Champions Garage with over 400 spaces. Parking passes are mobile delivery only, and no tailgating is allowed in the Champions Garage. Event day parking is card only.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Acrisure Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Acrisure Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including mobile ordering for beer and food to minimize wait times. Local favorites like Franco's Pizzeria and Franco's Italian Army Gridiron Sausages highlight the stadium's focus on Pittsburgh's culinary scene.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available on every stadium level, and all entry gates are accessible. Guests needing additional screening assistance can use the dedicated accessibility lane; contact Guest Services at 412-697-7150, option 4.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exit and re-entry are not permitted. For a medical emergency, request authorization at the Guest Services kiosk at Ticketmaster Gate B before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Ticket Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The Steelers Ticket Office and ticket will-call location are on the east side of the stadium along Art Rooney Avenue. Mobile tickets are standard and screenshots are not accepted.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Main entries are Gate A East, Gate A West, Ticketmaster Gate B, Heinz Gate C, and the FedEx Great Hall gates. For Steelers and Pitt football games, gates generally open two hours before kickoff; other events publish their own schedules.
